author: iris
title: Looking for Ukrainian character designer
content: Okay bc people in the replies are curious, I’m looking for a Ukrainian artist with a background in drawing traditional Ukrainian clothing to design me a modern vampire outfit with Ukrainian motifs. I would completely prefer to support a Ukrainian artist on this since they have the cultural background + I want to give Ukrainians money because I’m Ukrainian American. That’s all 🙏 I think it’s a little too specific. I’ve seen gorgeous character designers but I’m just looking for someone super specific!
